title: Lemony Falafel Wrap
description: A twist on traditional French cuisine, this leamy falafel wrap combines crispy falafel patties with crunchy vegetables and pita bread, all tied together with a zesty lemon sauce.
instructions: Prepare falafel mix according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and mayonnaise. Set aside.
Warm pita bread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading a spoonful of lemon sauce on the pita, then adding a few falafel patties, shredded lettuce, sliced tomato, sliced cucumber, and thinly sliced red onion.
Top with crunchy lettuce and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of lemon wedges for additional flavor.
